implementation: Unbounded nearest-position queries screen legal geometry directly and rank by exact rounded distance/x/y. Sorted y costs permit pruning a row only when its rounded distance is strictly worse than the best legal incumbent. Bounded alternative searches retain their frontier, ordering and node-budget semantics. No hardware limits or acceptance gates changed.

tests.accounting_changes: Three fully blocked fixtures now explicitly require zero distance-key calls. The old cross-algorithm receipt-equality assertion was replaced by independently instrumenting each path and retaining geometric equality. Initial stale assertions failed visibly; final cell-counter rerun passes. Actual scalar calls remain counted, not hypothetical heap work.
tests.oracle_coverage: Direct nearest poses compared to independent exhaustive geometry/ranking across asymmetric children, face masks, ties, windows and lattice sizes. Existing fractional-boundary and mutation oracles retained. Bounded frontier properties unchanged.

smaller_carrier_screen.limits: Functional screens, not controlled timing comparison: heap and pruned runs overlapped compilation/tests. No smaller accepted board. Spatial lookups increase while avoiding ordered traversal of rejected cells.

full_qualification.scope: Sequential isolated full board commands, all mandatory audits and rendering enabled. Carrier release recipe order 0 with carrier-162x150p5-connectivity.floorplan.json; devkit multiscale-outline. No concurrent campaign or source changes.
full_qualification.visual_review: Fresh top and bottom renders inspected for both boards; all PNG signatures/dimensions and timestamps checked; both PCB hashes match accepted references.

carrier_prior_isolated_reference.limits: Single historical before/after samples, same recipe and PCB hash, not a repeated statistical benchmark or language comparison.

limits: No new exhaustive CTest run, Python comparison, master publication or smaller carrier claimed. Compile time excluded from board wall times. Existing advisory failures and unknown hardware requirements remain. Routing is excluded; no fabrication readiness or broader goal completion.
